stem: At what age do Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander infants receive an additional dose of the 13-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine?
explanation: 6 months is the correct age for the additional 13-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine dose in Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander infants.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because the additional 13-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine dose is given at 6 months of age.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because 12 months is not the scheduled age for this extra pneumococcal conjugate vaccine dose.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because 18 months is later than the recommended timing for this additional dose.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because 4 years is not the age for an additional 13-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine dose.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because 2 years is not the scheduled age for this extra pneumococcal conjugate vaccine dose.

source.hint: This additional dose occurs midway through the first year of life.
